final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence. The response materially narrows the claim and correctly rejects any controls-only rationale, but that is a reinterpretation of the same record, not new proof. The core blocking predicate remains unresolved: policy requires disclosure of the material limitation for the named exposed use case unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch, and the record still contains neither the actual disclosure artifact nor approved risk acceptance. Aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and monitoring support operational readiness, but they do not establish compliance with the disclosure requirement. The most supportable conclusion remains that the Actor identified a plausible caveated path, not that compliance was achieved on the admissible evidence available here.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the launch model card or certification artifact actually discloses the grant compliance review allowable-cost explanation limitation for the exposed cohort.
No admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance signed by the proper approver and explicitly covering the exposed grant compliance review segment.
The narrowed caveated-certification theory is a policy interpretation of existing evidence, not proof that the required compliance predicate was satisfied before launch.
